facts.text: The Abbey Advantage Scholarship covers remaining tuition costs for eligible first-time, full-time North Carolina students pursuing a traditional major.

sources.title: Belmont Abbey College Expands Full Tuition Scholarship Statewide
sources.quote: Leveraging the students' state and federal grants first, the college will award an institutional merit award to cover the student's remaining tuition costs for the 2026-2027 academic year.

sources.title: Belmont Abbey College Expands Full Tuition Scholarship Statewide
sources.quote: The Abbey Advantage Scholarship is available to first-time, full-time non-athletes pursuing a traditional major of study.
